name: Green Corn Pudding
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: dozen full ears of sweet green corn
ingredients.originalText: two dozen full ears of sweet green corn

ingredients.name: a pint and a half or one quart of milk
ingredients.originalText: a pint and a half or one quart of milk
ingredients.quantityText: a pint and a half or one quart of milk

instructions.text: Score the kernels and cut them from the cob
Scrape off what remains on the cob with a knife
Add milk according to the youngness and juiciness of the corn
Add four eggs well beaten, flour, butter, sugar, and salt to taste
Bake in a well-greased earthen dish in hot oven two hours
Place on the table browned and smoking hot
Eat with plenty of fresh butter or serve with a sweet sauce as dessert

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Score the kernels and cut them from the cob
2. Scrape off what remains on the cob with a knife
3. Add milk according to the youngness and juiciness of the corn
4. Add four eggs well beaten, flour, butter, sugar, and salt to taste
5. Bake in a well-greased earthen dish in hot oven two hours
6. Place on the table browned and smoking hot
7. Eat with plenty of fresh butter or serve with a sweet sauce as dessert
